$schema: Protected resource metadata for CVE-2026-123272 (mcp-go before v1.2.1, CWE-346). `resource_url` is the MCP server the client connected to and built the metadata URL from. `malicious_document` is what a malicious server at that URL serves: its `resource` names another MCP server on the same authorization server, so a client that sends it as the RFC 8707 resource indicator gets a token minted for that server. `variants` are other `resource` values a server could declare in its place. `honest_document` is the control the guard must accept.
